source_text: A 2018 survivor-led survey of 83 Bohra women across Indian states found 50% experienced post-procedure irritation and 30% reported immediate discomfort during urination or walking, indicating complication rates of 10-50% in small samples, contrasting claims by community advocates of a "minor nick" with negligible harms. [16] [32]
